summary: Iteration 5 backend-only regression run (frontend testing explicitly skipped per request). Executed the full existing suite: 62/62 passed in 36.8s (backend_test.py 21, test_admin_failclosed.py 2, test_iteration2_fixes.py 7, test_plan_gating.py 6, test_storage_region.py 11, test_stripe_diagnostics.py 16). Additionally verified the 5 requested regressions live over HTTP against the running backend: (1) unauthenticated GET /api/admin/stripe-status -> 401 {'detail':'Not authenticated'} (reproduces the exact URL-bar symptom the user reported — expected behaviour); (2) authenticated admin GET /api/admin/stripe-status -> 200 with {'configured':false,'detail':'STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is not set on the server.'} because STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is blank in backend/.env — the configured=true + 4 lookup_keys + mode=test/live/unknown branches are covered by the monkeypatched in-process TestClient tests (test_status_fake_test_key_reports_missing_all, test_status_live_key_mode_detection, test_status_prices_found_reports_amounts) which all pass; (3) non-admin -> 403 (test_stripe_status_nonadmin_403 + test_status_nonadmin_403_inproc); (4) /api/payments/checkout no-price error still contains both 'lookup_key' and 'setup_stripe.py' (test_checkout_no_price_message_is_actionable). No backend regressions. Also code-reviewed the new StripeStatus component and lint-checked AdminIntegrations.jsx (clean); confirmed its field contract (configured/mode/lookup_keys[].exists/.amount/missing/action) matches server.py exactly. No new backend test files were needed.

ui_bugs.issue: No error state for the useQuery itself. If the request fails (403/500/network), data is undefined so configured is undefined and the widget renders the red X with the misleading message 'STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is not set on the server.' Should distinguish query error from configured=false using isError/error.

Contradictory render on the Stripe error branch: backend returns {configured:true, mode, error} with no 'missing' key, so missing.length===0 and the widget shows a GREEN check with 'All 4 plan prices found in <MODE> mode.' while simultaneously showing the red error box beneath it. Gate the green/success line on lookup_keys being present and !data.error.

rca_of_the_issue: User symptom (401 'Not authenticated' when opening /api/admin/stripe-status in the browser address bar) is by design: the endpoint calls require_admin(request) which reads the Authorization Bearer header, and a URL-bar navigation sends no such header (auth is not cookie-based). Verified with curl: no header -> 401, admin Bearer token -> 200. The iteration-5 fix (fetching via the authenticated axios client from the StripeStatus widget) addresses it correctly; no backend change was needed and none regressed.
